game.name: Zumba Fitness Rush (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Zumba Fitness Rush is a rhythm game for Xbox 360 that combines dance and fitness. Compatible with the Kinect motion-sensing device, it allows you to try out over 40 choreographies in 10 different locations. It is possible to track the number of calories lost over the weeks and playlists can be created and exchanged online.
game.genre: Music and Dancing, Sports / Fitness, Sports
